title: A few permissions
intro: Tantara needs them to work. You can change them in your phone settings.

mic.name: Microphone
mic.why: To record your voice on the stories.

camera.name: Camera and photos
camera.why: For the silly-face photo and the page photos.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.why: To tell you about a new voice or a review.

deniedHint: Denied: you can turn it on in your device settings.
unsupportedHint: This device does not allow it.
skipHint: You can continue even without allowing everything.
